Chapter 810: Chapter 18 Taiyang Divine Master And Taiyin Sovereign (8000 Words, Chapter Two-In-One)_5

Chapter 810: Chapter 18 Taiyang Divine Master and Taiyin Sovereign (8000 words, Chapter Two-in-One)_5

The three-headed black wolf Evil God was full of confusion. With Lin Yuan’s strength, shouldn’t he be venturing into the Void Secret Realm to become a Perfect Ninth Stage Evil God and then attempt to break through to the Tenth Stage?

“Just wait.”

“The Divine Masters will not let this go easily.”

The three-headed black wolf Evil God didn’t hesitate to turn around and leave, and upon seeing this, the dozens of other Evil Gods immediately followed. They were not as powerful as the three-headed black wolf Evil God, so naturally, they wouldn’t make any impulsive moves at this moment.

Lin Yuan watched the dozens of Evil Gods leave.

With his strength, he completely had the ability to keep all these Evil Gods behind, but doing so would inevitably reveal that he had already attained the power of a Perfect Ninth Stage.

...

In such circumstances, the ones to come and probe next time would not be ordinary Divine Masters like the three-headed black wolf Evil God, but a group of Perfect Ninth Stage Demonic Divine Masters.

This did not conform to Lin Yuan’s anticipated plan to ‘buy time,’ which is why he let these Evil Gods leave.

In the absence of major changes in the situation, Lin Yuan would naturally delay the arrival of the final battle as much as possible.

This way, he could secure the most time for cultivation.

For every additional day of cultivation, Lin Yuan might grasp the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm and thus sweep away all opposition.

“Why protect those ants?”

Lin Yuan’s mind flashed through the last sentence of the three-headed black wolf Evil God, and he shook his head slightly, “Who’s to blame when you Evil Gods cannot cultivate the Martial Tao?”

…..

For Lin Yuan, whether it was the Foreign Evil Gods or the beings within the World, anyone who could cultivate the Martial Tao and spread it would receive his protection.

Even if Evil Gods could cultivate Martial Tao, Lin Yuan would be more inclined to protect them. After all, the individual strength of Evil Gods is formidable, and they would inevitably advance rapidly in Martial Tao cultivation, giving birth to the first Sixth Stage Martial Tao, Seventh Stage Martial Tao, and even an Eighth Layer cultivator with breakneck speed.

The more Higher Rank cultivators there are on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the greater the assistance to Lin Yuan.

But unfortunately.

After more than three hundred years of research by Lin Yuan.

These Foreign Evil Gods were too reliant on their innate talents, and it was basically impossible for them to abandon those talents and cultivate the Martial Dao Cultivation Evolution Path.

Each Evil God’s path of cultivation is predetermined from their birth. As for changes later in life? Even if it can be done, it is extremely difficult and unlikely to achieve much success.

…

Void Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan continued to delve deeper into the Secret Realm, searching for many Void Creatures.

With a Mental Will Index reaching twenty million points, Ninth Stage Void Creatures were of little help to Lin Yuan.

But even if the help was small, it was still help; the increase in the Mental Will Index was just very slight.

A mosquito may be small, but it is still flesh. Lin Yuan naturally would not give up. With his current Mental Will Index, as long as there was an increase, it would be a gain.

If he returned to the Main Universe, he would not have such good opportunities; even a slight boost to the Mental Will Index would be difficult.

Lin Yuan is not a Supreme Being who can stand on the ‘shore’ for a long time and experience the ‘shore’s’ breath for training. Residing within the River of Time, a Mental Will Index of eighteen million points is already the limit.

Lin Yuan’s Mental Will Index surpassing twenty million points basically eliminates any possibility of further improvement.

“According to the current rate, in the next three hundred years, if no major unforeseen events occur, my Mental Will Index is expected to reach twenty-three million points.”

Lin Yuan estimated in his heart, feeling quite satisfied.

Just as Lin Yuan was planning to continue searching for Void Creatures.

Suddenly.

A powerful aura rapidly approached.

Lin Yuan looked up and saw a terrifying Evil God Divine Master gazing at him from afar.

“Eastern Wing Lord?”

Lin Yuan recognized the opponent. The Eastern Wing Lord was one of the very famous among the many Demonic Divine Masters, belonging to the Perfect Ninth Stage Evil God Divine Masters.

“Taiyang Divine Master.”

The Eastern Wing Lord’s face mustered a smile, showing sufficient goodwill to Lin Yuan.

Facing an existence of the same level, the Eastern Wing Lord naturally did not dare to show arrogance. A Perfect Ninth Stage Demonic Divine Master would be very haughty towards an ordinary Evil God Divine Master, but was quite humble when interacting with those of the same level.

Among Divine Master-level Evil Gods, it was good to avoid skirmishes and disputes, and this was even more true for Perfect Ninth Stage Divine Masters.

“I did not expect that after sleeping for hundreds of thousands of years, the Boundless Void would give birth to a strong being like the Taiyang Divine Master,” said the Eastern Wing Lord with a hint of emotion.

Although the rise of the Taiyang Divine Master took only three to five hundred years.

But the Eastern Wing Lord subconsciously thought that the existence of the Taiyang Divine Master was far longer than three to five hundred years; those were just the years during which the Taiyang Divine Master had revealed his strength.

“By sheer luck.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He didn’t mind communicating and exchanging ideas with a Perfect Ninth Stage Demonic Divine Master. With his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, Lin Yuan could often perceive many extraordinary pieces of information from the other party.

After chatting casually with the Eastern Wing Lord for half an hour, the conversation suddenly turned, and the Eastern Wing Lord solemnly asked, “I came to seek the Taiyang Divine Master to join forces against an enemy.”

“An enemy?”

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly grave.

In the Boundless Void, Evil Gods are the absolute dominions, so what other enemy could there be?

“I wonder if the Taiyang Divine Master… has heard of the Taiyin Sovereign?” asked the Eastern Wing Lord in a deep voice.
